# Data Contract: CFD Summary Files

Each finished CFD case writes one file: `results/summaries/<case_id>.json`.
The ML code reads only these files. Any change to this format must be agreed on by both
team members and the schema test updated.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Units | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| case_id | string | — | Unique ID from `cases/manifest.csv` |
| design_id | string | — | Design grid point |
| scenario_id | string | — | Growth stage x flow condition |
| patient_id | string | — | Virtual patient |
| power_loss | float | TODO (e.g., mW) | Control-volume energy loss |
| ipl | float | dimensionless | Indexed power loss (formula source: TODO) |
| hfd_lpa | float | fraction (0-1) | Fraction of hepatic (IVC) flow to the left pulmonary artery |
| low_wss_frac | float | fraction (0-1) | Fraction of conduit wall area below the low-WSS threshold |
| converged | bool | — | Whether all convergence criteria were met |
| final_residuals | object | — | Final residual per field |
| iterations | int | — | Solver iterations |
| runtime_s | float | s | Wall-clock time |
| machine | string | — | "pc" or "mbp" |
| openfoam_version | string | — | Must match across machines |
| git_commit | string | — | Commit hash of the code that produced the case |

## Rules

- Unconverged cases are kept with `converged: false` and excluded from analysis (counted, not deleted).
- Units never change without updating this document and the schema test.
